items.requirement: Exactly two distinct actual human reviewers must provide signed identity attestations. Agents, automated evidence passes, and test oracles are not reviewers.

A frozen corpus must contain exactly 200 judgments grouped by explicit clusterId, with exhaustive expected output sets, qualifying source evidence, two independent human reviews, and a human adjudication for every case.

Replay public npm 3.8.3 against the frozen human corpus and retain exhaustive per-case outputs, raw artifact hashes, a confusion matrix, and separate precision and recall denominators and two-sided 95% Wilson intervals.
Replay final 3.9.3 packed or public artifacts against the same corpus with exhaustive per-case outputs and independently recomputable precision and recall metrics.
